data.exact_reserve_text: The result for the year included net prior year reserve strengthening of GBP 9.8m (2021: reserve release of GBP 2.1m) which deteriorated the combined ratio by 5.5% (2021: benefit of 1.5%). This strengthening was driven by reserve increases in relation to the China flood losses in Henan and Typhoon Rai, both on our Treaty Property Reinsurance class of business, partly offset by reserve releases on our professional lines class following favourable loss experience.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2022 was GBP 424.046m. Using the gross claims development table, aggregate prior-year development across underwriting years up to 2020 produced a net favourable movement (release) of approximately GBP 14.2m (3.35% of opening gross claims). The Managing Agent reports a net prior year reserve strengthening of GBP 9.8m on a net-of-reinsurance basis driven by reserve increases related to China (Henan) floods and Typhoon Rai in the Treaty Property Reinsurance class, partly offset by favourable development on Professional Lines. There is a material difference between the reported net figure and the gross development derived from the claims triangle, reflecting reinsurance effects and recoverables.

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit gross prior-year movement figure was provided in the notes; the Managing Agent reports a net prior year strengthening of GBP 9.8m (net of reinsurance). A gross prior-year movement was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (page 48), yielding a net gross release of GBP 14.204m. The difference between the reported net figure and the triangle-derived gross figure reflects reinsurance recoveries and movements in reinsurers' share. Prior-year movement confidence is moderate (0.8) because the gross movement was derived from the triangle rather than an explicit gross prior-year movement note.
